column1: # Alpine crossing: Hsu's injury, rescue, workers after clearing, Lama Temple visitors and Lamakan gameplay hints.

column3: Should I go back to Xian? I\ncan't be much help standing\nhere, can I?{end_now}
... ... I haven't eaten\nsince morning. I'm\nstarving.{end_wait}
Hsu! Can you hear me? Say\nsomething!{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}! You came! Hsu's\npinned between the rocks.\nWe can't move them{page_break}ourselves.{end_wait}
Stay with us, Hsu! We're\ngoing to get you out!{end_wait}
I'm trapped between the\nboulders. I can't move my\nleg. At least they didn't{page_break}crush me.{end_wait}
Those rocks are too heavy.\nHow are we supposed to move\nthem?{end_wait}
Hsu's getting weaker. We\ncan't leave him here much\nlonger.{end_wait}
I want to shout for help,\nbut Feizhi's frightened\nenough already.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, you moved it? How\ndid you lift a rock that\nsize?{end_wait}
I haven't forgotten what\nyou did for Hsu. Thank you.\nAll of you.{end_wait}
If you're crossing Lamakan\nDesert, take plenty of\nwater. People get lost{page_break}there.{end_wait}
The heat in Lamakan is\nunbearable. Find the oases\nbefore you go any farther.{end_wait}
Master Hama teaches that\nmeditation can sharpen a\nperson's sight of what lies{page_break}ahead.{end_wait}
The desert wasn't always so\ndangerous. I hope it\nreturns to normal someday.{end_wait}

Watch your temperature in
the desert. When it reaches
the limit, the heat starts{page_break}hurting you. Find an oasis
before that happens.{end_wait}
I wouldn't cross Lamakan\nfor a chest of gold. Not in\nthat heat.{end_wait}
Something in the desert\nbends even the light. I\ncan't see how people find{page_break}their way.{end_wait}
If I could see what was\ncoming, maybe I'd stop\nmaking the same mistakes.{end_wait}
Master Hama is worried\nabout you. Please don't\ntake unnecessary risks out{page_break}there.{end_wait}
Reveal can show oases your\neyes can't see. Remember\nthat in the desert.{end_wait}
North: Altin Mine. West:\nLama Temple.{end_wait}
I've been traveling from\nvillage to village. Most\npeople are kinder than{page_break}rumors make them sound.{end_wait}

Those travelers have the
same strange feeling as
Master Hama. It's as if{page_break}someone is looking into my
thoughts.{end_wait}
The rocks are finally out\nof the way. At least\ntravelers can use the road{page_break}again.{end_wait}
People came all the way\nfrom Xian to help clear the\npath. They worked until{page_break}their hands were raw.{end_wait}
The path is open, but there\nare still boulders here. Do\nwe have to move every last{page_break}one?{end_wait}
I nearly threw my back out\nlifting those stones. Next\ntime, I'll train first.{end_wait}
